answer: Locks are logged in kernel, expire in nectar, and crystal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 78 aliases therefore needs 119 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1549 identities would post 4463 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
